project.title: Kakadu Cultural Weekend
project.description: A two-day trip to Kakadu National Park with a Traditional Owner-led cultural walk, so international students learn about the Territory and its First Nations culture.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Social connection and wellbeing for international students.
